scope: Focused read-only re-review of same allowed seven immutable files; D5 overview quality only. No project imports, source edits, generator/tests, inference, model/cloud/native tools, private logs or final assets.
snapshot_source_identity: uncommitted corrected D1-D5 source, immutable copy

findings.title: Email and note targets still mainly enumerate full supplied text
findings.evidence: Topic and scope repair is complete. Email bullets retain subject, sender and body but repeat the same Requested by date for each item; notes still repeat Status: draft and each full text. Messages now use genuine attributed paraphrases and weekly rows group across days. Remaining concern is style/coverage for longer summaries, not factual correctness.
findings.fix_direction: Optional future enrichment: consolidate shared requested-by dates and draft qualifiers, and use larger mixed-topic fixtures that require prioritization and grouping.
findings.reproduction: Compare these row answers with their fixture item bodies/text and requested_by values.

findings.title: Weekly and delivery-state additions cover the missing basics but remain narrow
findings.evidence: 33 weekly fixtures have actual multi-day coverage and correct chronological date grouping; 33 draft_sent fixtures explicitly label one draft and one sent record, with delivery_state consistent with sent. Weekly rows contain only two or three calendar events and one or two reminder due dates; no mixed-topic or busy-week selection challenge. The delivery fixtures reuse received_date/sender/body on both states rather than demonstrate a fuller realistic outgoing record. This does not invalidate the explicit draft/sent labels.
findings.fix_direction: Optional future enrichment: larger weeks, mixed topics, unplaced/no-due reminders, irregular intervals, and realistic authored/sent timestamps and recipient fields for outgoing records.
findings.reproduction: Inventory weekly_agenda and draft_sent fixture item counts and fields, then inspect listed representative rows.

v1_resolution.GROUNDED-01: RESOLVED: every one of 306 supplied email subjects appears in its answer.
v1_resolution.GROUNDED-02: RESOLVED for nonempty email/messages: every supplied account/date/conversation and unread=true qualifier appears; returned counts present except explicitly labeled draft/sent records.
v1_resolution.GROUNDED-03: Core missing weekly and draft/sent coverage RESOLVED: 33 actual multi-day weekly rows and 33 explicit draft/sent rows. Broader realistic variety remains a future improvement.
v1_resolution.GROUNDED-04: PARTIALLY RESOLVED: all 270 message bodies are now meaning-preserving speaker-attributed paraphrases, and weekly rows synthesize chronological cross-source agendas. Email/note enumeration remains a minor nonblocking note.

all_row_checks.method: Independent static JSON/literal/regex checks of all rows. Compare item facts and source statuses, nonempty overview scope/counts, meaning-preserving message body transforms with speaker attribution, weekly inclusive date range and per-item date grouping/order, and delivery_state/sent consistency. No existing generator/tests used.

verdict_limits: Advisory grounding/quality verdict on immutable overview subset only. No blocker for scoped D5 repairs. Does not certify model training efficacy, generalization, candidate mechanical tests, CI, or final artifact identity.
